text:
deploy-bot: config-only rollout started. rollout_id: r-d4f7. change-window 16:00-16:30 UTC. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% over two steps. Config diffs: token_bucket.capacity: 5000 -> 3500, token_bucket.refill_ms: 60000 -> 45000, per_worker_concurrency: 10 -> 7, idle_timeout_ms: 120000 -> 90000, batch_window_ms: 80 -> 60. No model or weights changes.
sam: ack. who is watching dashboards?
priya: I'll watch p50/p95/p99, 4xx/5xx, and token_bucket_drop_rate. watching 16:02-16:20. :mag: 
eva: perf note: lower token capacity + faster refill can increase drops transiently during tenant bursts. recommend cohort ramp: keep heavy-tenants at old config for first ramp.
ops-lead: added cohort plan to rollout: canary step1: 2% limited to low-volume tenants; step2: 10% include medium tenants; heavy tenants stay pinned for 30m unless cleared. Manual promotion between steps. Pin playbook in notes.
chris: added rollback policy: if p99 > 700ms for 120s OR 5xx_rate > 0.6% for 60s OR token_bucket_drop_rate > 5% sustained 2m, trigger manual pause and evaluate. snippet: 
```
{"rollback_conditions":[{"metric":"p99_latency_ms","threshold":700,"duration_s":120},{"metric":"5xx_rate_pct","threshold":0.6,"duration_s":60},{"metric":"token_bucket_drop_pct","threshold":5,"duration_s":120}]}
```
priya: good. add tenant-pin command for ops here:
```
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/tenants/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant_id":"T-900","route":"stable-config","duration":"30m"}'
```
sam: can we also include a step to increase observability tags for affected requests? add header tagging for rollout so we can filter traces by cohort.
ops-lead: done, rollout will include header X-Deploy-Rollout: r-d4f7 for canary traffic.
deploy-bot: step1 canary (2%) applied at 2755554365 limited to low-volume tenants. initial metrics +90s: p50=88ms p95=210ms p99=380ms 5xx=0.01% token_bucket_drop=0.4%. no alerts.
eva: saw a small drop rate blip to 1.2% for 30s aligned with a micro-burst from tenant T-102. within rollback limits but note.
priya: recommend hold at step1 for full 12m observation, then manual proceed to step2. if any heavy-tenant shows >200ms p95 delta, pin them immediately.
chris: ops ready to execute pin if needed. pin CLI prepped in runbook.
deploy-bot: holding at 2% (step1) 12m elapsed. latest: p50=85ms p95=205ms p99=395ms 5xx=0.02% token_bucket_drop=0.6%. no auto-rollback triggered.
sam: given stability, I'll coordinate manual ramp to step2 at end of window: 10% including medium tenants. will notify ops 2m before ramp.
ops-lead: copy. standby for DM to execute ramp. will ensure pager coverage.
priya: updating release notes: include exact config diffs, cohort plan, rollback JSON, pin commands, observability tags, and change-window. :memo:
deploy-bot: step1 complete at 2755554600. awaiting manual decision to ramp to 10%.
